name: Hootsuite MCP Server
headline: Hootsuite MCP Server: Social Media Management for
short_description: MCP server that integrates Hootsuite with AI agents, enabling social media post creation, scheduling, analytics retrieval, and profile management through API access.
author: LokiMCPUniverse

sections.overview:
The Hootsuite MCP Server connects Hootsuite's social media management platform to GenAI applications through the Model Context Protocol. It provides comprehensive API coverage for creating and scheduling posts, retrieving analytics, managing social profiles, and deleting posts. The server supports multiple authentication methods including OAuth tokens and API keys, with enterprise-ready features like rate limiting, error handling, and async support. Teams and marketers can automate social media workflows by integrating Hootsuite capabilities directly into AI agents running in Claude Code or Cursor.
Automate social media post scheduling across multiple platforms
Retrieve and analyze social media performance metrics programmatically
Manage connected social profiles and post content in bulk
Delete or modify scheduled posts through AI agent commands
